name: Family Reunification (Spouse and Minor Children of a Resident)

requirements.blocker_text: Applies to the spouse and minor children of an established resident. Requires proof of the sponsor's own resident status, sufficient income (reported at roughly EUR 500/month per dependent by this source), and adequate housing.
requirements.fix_path: Establish the family relationship to an established resident and document sufficient income and housing.

evidence_required.document: Proof of family relationship (marriage or birth certificate)
Proof of the sponsor's residency status

outcome.duration_length: tied to the sponsor's resident card tier

sources.title: Openshores -- Republic of Congo family reunification: spouse and minor children of an established resident, income and housing requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Congo-Brazzaville). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-3 sourced only. This route covers the spouse and minor children of an established RESIDENT (any nationality). A separate, faster CITIZENSHIP route exists specifically for a foreign woman marrying a CONGOLESE CITIZEN man (see cg_citizenship_naturalisation.json) -- the two are not the same mechanism and are modeled separately. This dataset found no broader reunification provision for parents or adult children of a resident or citizen.
